_meta._note: Runtime values of apps/client for the F02 spike (read by apps/client/src/config/runtime.ts). Build-time URLs stay in VITE_* env vars (tech note section 8), not here. Nothing in this file affects a reward; HUD numbers are spike measurements only. Keys starting with '_' are metadata: code skips them. null = not set yet: code must fail loudly. seeFile keys point at the single source of a value owned elsewhere.

locationWeb._source: docs/tech/F02-map-location-spike.md section 4 row 'ค่า Web' (ค่าแนะนำเริ่มต้น true, 15000, 0)
locationWeb._note: Passed to navigator.geolocation.watchPosition as PositionOptions { enableHighAccuracy, timeout: timeout_ms, maximumAge: maximumAge_ms } inside packages/location/src/web/ only. The tech note wrote timeoutMs/maximumAgeMs; renamed to the unit-suffix convention (ADR 0001 3.10). maximumAge_ms 0 = never accept a cached fix

providerQuery._source: docs/tech/F02-map-location-spike.md section 3 (query loc, trace, speed, loop, hud; ค่าเริ่มต้นต่อ environment มาจาก client config; ค่าที่ไม่รู้จัก → ใช้ค่าเริ่มต้นและเตือนใน console)
providerQuery._note: capacitor is selectable but the stub reports not-implemented (tests the error path). traceWhenUnset: first trace of the import.meta.glob list (gps-trace-format section 5) that passes validateTrace. Boolean params use '1'/'0' in the URL

_source.development: docs/tech/F02-map-location-spike.md section 3 (mock = ค่าเริ่มต้นใน dev)
_source.production: docs/tech/F02-map-location-spike.md section 3 (web = ค่าเริ่มต้นใน preview); section 13 (window.__kwSpike เฉพาะเมื่อ hud=1)

providerQueryDefaultsByMode._note: Keyed by Vite import.meta.env.MODE. 'production' covers vite build, i.e. the Cloudflare Pages preview and the field-walk build. An unknown MODE falls back to 'production' with a console warning (safer: real GPS, HUD off)
providerQueryDefaultsByMode._assumption: A-P1-H05-1: the tech note gives no default for speed or loop. speed 1 (real time) everywhere; loop on in development so a demo keeps moving, off in production where mock is only used on purpose. Owner: tech-lead

mapView._note: MapLibre Map option maxZoom. The source maxzoom comes from TileJSON or the PMTiles header, never from here

hudMeasurement._note: Spike measurements only, never sent to a server and never a reward. The gate window length, distance and comparison are read from dungeons.json#movementGate (single source); the TTFF threshold from anticheat.json. Changing these values after the field walk starts breaks comparability with the pre-set criteria in tech note section 10 (TL-M04)
